This organisation is fictional.
Adopted on 12 February 2025; effective from 1 March 2025.

Repay a powered-tool deposit within 7 calendar days after return and inspection.
Repay it by the original payment method unless the member agrees otherwise.
### 1.2 Deductions
Deduct only a confirmed repair or replacement charge for that tool from its deposit.
Give the member a written calculation; any balance owed remains payable.

## 2 Membership refunds
### 2.1 Unused membership
Refund the full annual fee if a written request reaches the desk within 7 calendar days of joining.
This applies only if neither named adult has collected any item during that membership.
The joining date is day zero when counting the request period.
### 2.2 Other cancellations
There is no membership refund after an item has been collected or for an unused renewal.
A conduct suspension does not qualify for a refund.
### 2.3 Refund payment
Pay an approved membership refund within 14 calendar days of receiving the request.

## 3 Loss and damage
### 3.1 Assessment
Do not charge for ordinary wear; charge actual repair cost for avoidable damage, up to £40 per item.
For a lost or irreparable item, charge its recorded replacement value, capped at £60 per item.
### 3.2 Notice and payment
Give written notice of the calculation; payment is due within 14 days of that notice.
Overdue charges remain separate; appeals follow lend-conduct.md and waivers follow lend-fees.md.

The fee is payable on joining and on each renewal.

The annual fee is £12 if either named adult declares that the household receives income support.
No benefit letter is required; record the declaration on the application.
The reduced fee cannot be combined with any other fee reduction.

## 3 Deposits and records
### 3.1 Tool deposit
Collect a refundable £20 deposit for each powered tool before handing it over.
No deposit is required for toys or hand tools.
Deposit deductions and repayment times are set out in lend-refunds.md.

An unpaid charge blocks new loans and renewal until paid or formally waived.
A pending appeal does not remove this block.

# Membership Rules
This organisation is fictional.
Adopted on 12 February 2025; effective from 1 March 2025.

## 1 Who may join
### 1.1 Age and address
Members must be at least 18 and live in the fictional town of Osterby.
Bring one document showing your name and current address, dated within the last 3 months.
### 1.2 Household membership
One membership covers up to 2 named adults living at the same address.
Children may use borrowed toys but cannot hold membership or collect loans.

## 2 Starting and renewing
### 2.1 Membership term
Membership lasts 12 calendar months from the joining or renewal date.
Renewal starts on the date the renewal payment is accepted, not on the old expiry date.
### 2.2 Activation
Membership starts only when the application is approved and the annual fee is paid.
Annual fees and concessions are set out in lend-fees.md.
A member with an unpaid charge cannot renew until it is paid or formally waived.

## 3 Records and permissions
### 3.1 Named borrowers
Either named adult may collect items and is responsible for following lend-borrowing.md.
The first adult named on the application is responsible for household charges.
### 3.2 Changes and expiry
Tell the desk about an address or contact change within 14 days.
Expired memberships cannot take new loans; existing return dates still apply.
### 3.3 Reading these rules
Read these rules with the other governing files and applicable entries in lend-changes.md.
An applicable replacement in lend-changes.md prevails over the original section.

**Yes, a full refund of £30 is due, and it must be paid by Friday 24 July 2026.**

- **Fee:** The household paid on 1 July 2026, which is after 1 January 2026. The replacement in `lend-changes.md` §2 therefore applies, and the standard annual fee is £30, not the original £24 in `lend-fees.md` §2.1.
- **Refund window:** The request reached the desk on 10 July 2026, which is after 1 July 2026. The replacement in `lend-changes.md` §4 therefore applies, and it allows 14 calendar days from joining instead of 7. Joining on 1 July is day zero, so 10 July is day 9. That is inside the window. Under the original 7-day rule it would have been too late (the cutoff was 8 July).
- **Condition:** Neither named adult collected an item, so the "unused membership" condition is met.
- **Payment deadline:** `lend-refunds.md` §2.3 requires an approved refund to be paid within 14 calendar days of receiving the request. Counting from 10 July gives 24 July 2026.

This assumes the household paid the standard fee. If either adult had declared income support, the fee would have been £12 and so would the refund.
